_doc: Ohm's Brownout Pucks (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2; our own device): his ability, the item in his slot 2 (Z). A flat puck thrown (Fire) or lobbed (ADS) that skids along the floor instead of bouncing (little comes back off a surface, little is lost along it at each touch). `use.restS` after it comes to rest it pulses once: every defenders' electronic device and body within `emp.radiusM` (a sphere, through walls and floors) is off and jammed for `emp.seconds` (gadgets/DESIGN.md §6's EMP: longer and wider than the Impact EMP Grenade's). One bullet destroys it before it pulses (fragile). 3 a round. Its numbers are ours.
name: Brownout Puck
